name: model_op_fused_norm_rope
description: Fused Q/KV RMSNorm + interleaved RoPE + indexer-K LayerNorm/RoPE for DeepSeek-V3.2 MLA (vllm/models/deepseek_v32/common/kernels.py::fused_norm_rope). positions [num_tokens] int; q_c [num_tokens, q_dim] and kv_c [num_tokens, kv_dim] bfloat16/float16 with RMSNorm weights q_rms_norm_w [q_dim] and kv_rms_norm_w [kv_dim] plus their eps; k_pe [num_tokens, 2*half_rot] carrying the interleaved RoPE pairs; k_rope_cos_sin_cache [max_pos, 2*half_rot] float32 with cos in the first half of the last dim and sin in the second; index_k [num_tokens, index_k_dim] with LayerNorm weight/bias and eps, rotated by index_k_rope_cos_sin_cache in either interleaved (index_rope_interleave true) or NeoX split-half form; topk_indices_buffer [num_tokens, topk] int32 is filled with -1 when has_indexer. Returns (q_c_out, kv_c_out, k_pe_out, index_k_out, topk_indices_buffer). All RMS/Layer norms and rotations are computed in float32 and cast once on store. The paged-cache write path (slot_mapping, indexer_k_cache, mla_kv_cache and their fp8 quantization) is out of scope for this entry: those write into external caches and select among several vendor-specific fp8 layouts.
